corrections.old_text: ዓለም ።⟫ ማር ፲ ፲፮ ሉቃ ፲፰ ፲፰
corrections.corrected_text: ዓለም ።⟫ ማር ፲ ፲፯ ሉቃ ፲፰ ፲፰
corrections.reason: The printed numeral in the cross-reference is clearly ፲፯ (Mark 10:17, the parallel passage for the Rich Young Ruler), not ፲፮.
Both visually in the scan and grammatically in Amharic (አላመነም ብሎ = 'saying/knowing that he did not believe'), the initial letter is 1st-order አ, not 6th-order እ.
The printed glyph at the end of ፍጹምነትን is clearly the accusative marker ን (translating Ge'ez ፍጹመ ከመ ትኩን), not ስ.
